exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI:

  • SABABNI 'BECAUSE' bilan, NATIJANI 'SO' bilan
    ifodalaymiz.
  • SABAB yoki MAQSADNI 'TO + fe'l' bilan ham
    ifodalaymiz (maqsad infinitivi).


UCh NAMUNA — BIR XIL FIKR, UCh XIL SHAKL:

  1) BECAUSE (sabab):
     'She's going to join a gym BECAUSE she wants
      to lose some weight.'
     (U sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi, CHUNKI vazn
      tashlamoqchi.)

  2) SO (natija):
     'She wants to lose some weight, SO she's
      going to join a gym.'
     (U vazn tashlamoqchi, ShUNING UChUN sport
      zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi.)

  3) TO + fe'l (maqsad):
     'She's going to join a gym TO LOSE some
      weight.'
     (U vazn tashlash UChUN sport zaliga a'zo
      bo'lmoqchi.)


ENG MUHIM — GAP TARTIBI:

  BECAUSE:
     [NATIJA] because [SABAB]
     'join a gym'  ←  'wants to lose weight'
     Ya'ni SABAB 'because' dan KEYIN.

  SO:
     [SABAB], so [NATIJA]
     'wants to lose weight'  →  'join a gym'
     Ya'ni NATIJA 'so' dan KEYIN.

  TARTIB TESKARI! Bu — eng ko'p xato qilinadigan
  joy.


'TO + fe'l' (maqsad infinitivi):
  Eng QISQA shakl.
  Ergash gapda EGA YO'Q:
     'to lose some weight'  ✓
     'to she loses weight'  ✗

  DIQQAT: 'because' dan keyin EGA va FE'L bo'ladi
  ('because SHE WANTS'), 'to' dan keyin esa
  faqat FE'L.


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR:

  'I'm going to the shop BECAUSE I need some
   milk.'
  'I need some milk, SO I'm going to the shop.'
  'I'm going to the shop TO BUY some milk.'

  'He studies hard BECAUSE he wants to pass his
   exams.'
  'He wants to pass his exams, SO he studies
   hard.'
  'He studies hard TO PASS his exams.'


DIQQAT — 93-BETDAGI Speaking MAShQI BILAN
BOG'LIQ:
  U yerda 'because' yoki 'to-inf' bilan gaplarni
  birlashtirgan edingiz:
     'She is going to join a gym TO LOSE some
      weight.'
     'She is going to relax BECAUSE she's quite
      tired.'
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 95-bet, 'Expressing Reason, Result or Purpose' qutisi

points.noteUz:

because dan keyin — SABAB.
so dan keyin — NATIJA.

points.en: We also express reason or purpose with to-infinitive (infinitive of purpose).

'to' dan keyin ega YO'Q — faqat fe'l.

points.en: She's going to join a gym because she wants to lose some weight.

'so' dan oldin VERGUL.

exercises.instructionEn: Match Tony's intentions to his reasons.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI USTUN:

  INTENTIONS (niyatlar):
     1  save money            (pul yig'moq)
     2  join a gym            (sport zaliga a'zo
                               bo'lmoq)
     3  stop eating sweets    (shirinlik yeyishni
                               to'xtatmoq)
     4  study hard            (qattiq o'qimoq)
     5  learn English         (ingliz tilini
                               o'rganmoq)

  REASON/PURPOSE (sabab/maqsad):
     a  keep fit              (sog'lom bo'lmoq)
     b  pass his exams        (imtihonlardan
                               o'tmoq)
     c  go on holiday         (ta'tilga bormoq)
     d  lose weight           (vazn tashlamoq)
     e  get a better job      (yaxshiroq ish
                               topmoq)


Kitob BIRINCHISINI chizib bergan: 1 → c


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  save money         →  c  go on holiday
  2  join a gym         →  a  keep fit
  3  stop eating sweets →  d  lose weight
  4  study hard         →  b  pass his exams
  5  learn English      →  e  get a better job


QANDAY ANIQLANADI — MANTIQ:

  1  Nega pul yig'adi? — TA'TILGA borish uchun
     (ta'til pul talab qiladi).

  2  Nega sport zaliga boradi? — SOG'LOM bo'lish
     uchun.
     DIQQAT: 'lose weight' ham mumkindek
     ko'rinadi, lekin u 3-band uchun ajratilgan.

  3  Nega shirinlik yeyishni to'xtatadi? —
     VAZN TAShLASh uchun.
     Shirinlik → vazn ortadi, demak to'xtatish →
     vazn tashlash.

  4  Nega qattiq o'qiydi? — IMTIHONLARDAN O'TISh
     uchun.

  5  Nega ingliz tilini o'rganadi? — YAXShIROQ ISh
     topish uchun.


DIQQAT — 2 va 3-BANDLAR ALDAMChI:
  'join a gym' bilan 'lose weight' ham,
  'keep fit' ham mos keladi.
  LEKIN 'stop eating sweets' faqat 'lose weight'
  bilan mos keladi ('keep fit' bilan emas).
  Shuning uchun:
     3 → d (lose weight)
     2 → a (keep fit)

  Bu — MANTIQIY ISTISNO usuli: avval faqat
  BITTA javobi bor bandni hal qiling.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to keep fit  = sog'lom, formada bo'lmoq
  to pass an exam = imtihondan o'tmoq
     (aksi: 'to FAIL an exam' — yiqilmoq)
  sweets       = shirinliklar
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq

pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDA ChIZILGAN.
Nega pul yig'adi? — TA'TILGA borish uchun.
Ta'til pul talab qiladi.

Nega sport zaliga boradi? — SOG'LOM bo'lish
uchun.
DIQQAT: 'lose weight' ham mos kelardi, lekin u
3-band uchun ajratilgan (quyidagi izohga qarang).
'to keep fit' = formada bo'lmoq.

Shirinlik → vazn ortadi.
Demak to'xtatish → VAZN TAShLASh.
BU BAND KALIT: 'stop eating sweets' faqat
'lose weight' bilan mos keladi — 'keep fit'
bilan emas.
Shuning uchun 'lose weight' shu yerga ketadi,
'keep fit' esa 2-bandga.

Nega qattiq o'qiydi? — IMTIHONLARDAN O'TISh
uchun.
'to pass an exam' = imtihondan o'tmoq.
Aksi: 'to FAIL an exam' (yiqilmoq).

Nega ingliz tilini o'rganadi? — YAXShIROQ ISh
topish uchun.
'a BETTER job' — QIYOSIY daraja (Unit 12).
93-betdagi Jennining xatida ham shu ibora bor edi:
'I want to find a better job in autumn.'

exercises.instructionEn: Then make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA (1-band uchun):

  1) 'Tony is going to save money BECAUSE he wants
      to go on holiday.'
  2) 'Tony wants to go on holiday, SO he is going
      to save money.'
  3) 'Tony is going to save money TO GO on
      holiday.'

  Demak HAR BIR band uchun UChTA gap tuziladi!


QOLIPLAR:

  1) BECAUSE:
     'Tony is going to [NIYAT] BECAUSE he wants to
      [SABAB].'

  2) SO:
     'Tony wants to [SABAB], SO he is going to
      [NIYAT].'

  3) TO + fe'l:
     'Tony is going to [NIYAT] TO [SABAB].'


BARCHA BESh BAND — UChTADAN GAP:

─── 1  save money / go on holiday ───  (NAMUNA)
  Tony is going to save money because he wants to
  go on holiday.
  Tony wants to go on holiday, so he is going to
  save money.
  Tony is going to save money to go on holiday.

─── 2  join a gym / keep fit ───
  Tony is going to join a gym because he wants to
  keep fit.
  Tony wants to keep fit, so he is going to join a
  gym.
  Tony is going to join a gym to keep fit.

─── 3  stop eating sweets / lose weight ───
  Tony is going to stop eating sweets because he
  wants to lose weight.
  Tony wants to lose weight, so he is going to
  stop eating sweets.
  Tony is going to stop eating sweets to lose
  weight.

─── 4  study hard / pass his exams ───
  Tony is going to study hard because he wants to
  pass his exams.
  Tony wants to pass his exams, so he is going to
  study hard.
  Tony is going to study hard to pass his exams.

─── 5  learn English / get a better job ───
  Tony is going to learn English because he wants
  to get a better job.
  Tony wants to get a better job, so he is going
  to learn English.
  Tony is going to learn English to get a better
  job.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI (har banddan bittadan):
  1  Toni pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga
     bormoqchi.
  2  Toni sport zaliga a'zo bo'lmoqchi, chunki
     sog'lom bo'lmoqchi.
  3  Toni shirinlik yeyishni to'xtatmoqchi, chunki
     vazn tashlamoqchi.
  4  Toni qattiq o'qimoqchi, chunki imtihonlardan
     o'tmoqchi.
  5  Toni ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi, chunki
     yaxshiroq ish topmoqchi.


DIQQAT — 'STOP EATING':
  'stop' dan keyin fe'l '-ING' oladi:
     'stop EATING sweets'  ✓
     'stop to eat sweets'  — boshqa ma'no
       (yeyish uchun to'xtamoq)

DIQQAT — 'SO' DAN OLDIN VERGUL:
  'Tony wants to go on holiday, SO he is going to
   save money.'
  Vergul SHART.

modelSentences.uz: Toni ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi. (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA — eng qisqa shakl)

modelSentences.uz: Toni vazn tashlash uchun shirinlik yeyishni to'xtatmoqchi. ('stop' + fe'l-ING)

modelSentences.uz: Toni imtihonlardan o'tish uchun qattiq o'qimoqchi. ('pass an exam' — o'tmoq)

modelSentences.word: 5  learn English / get a better job
modelSentences.sentence: Tony is going to learn English because he wants to get a better job. / Tony wants to get a better job, so he is going to learn English. / Tony is going to learn English to get a better job.
modelSentences.uz: Toni yaxshiroq ish topish uchun ingliz tilini o'rganmoqchi. ('a better job' — qiyosiy daraja)

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — 'WILL' NING IKKI VAZIFASI:

  We use WILL:

  1) TO MAKE PREDICTIONS (bashorat qilish)
     'In 100 years' time, there WILL BE underwater
      cities.'
     (100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar
      bo'ladi.)
     → Bu shunchaki FIKR, dalil yo'q.

  2) TO MAKE ON-THE-SPOT DECISIONS
     (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)
     'I'LL HAVE soup first, then steak and chips.'
     (Avval sho'rva, keyin bifshteks va kartoshka
      olaman.)
     → Menyuga qarab AYNI DAMDA hal qildi.


KELASI ZAMON BILAN IShLATILADIGAN VAQT IBORALARI:
     tomorrow              (ertaga)
     soon                  (yaqinda)
     next week/month/etc   (keyingi hafta/oy)
     the day after tomorrow (indinga)
     in 100 years' time    (100 yildan keyin)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'WILL' va 'BE GOING TO':

  BASHORATDA:
     'It's GOING TO rain.'
        → DALIL bor (qora bulutlar KO'RINIB
          turibdi)
     'I think it WILL rain.'
        → shunchaki FIKR, dalil YO'Q

  QARORDA:
     'I'M GOING TO join a gym.'
        → OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja
     'I'LL close the window.'
        → AYNI DAMDA hal qilindi
          (sovqotgani uchun)


QANDAY AJRATISh — SODDA USUL:
  Qaror QAChON qabul qilingan?
     ALLAQAChON  →  BE GOING TO
     HOZIRGINA   →  WILL

  Bashorat NIMAGA asoslangan?
     KO'RINIB turgan DALILGA  →  BE GOING TO
     shunchaki FIKRGA         →  WILL


'WILL' NING ShAKLLARI:
  TASDIQ:  ega + WILL + ASOSIY fe'l
              'I will close the window.'
              → 'I'LL close the window.'
  INKOR:   ega + WON'T + ASOSIY fe'l
              'It won't rain.'
  SO'ROQ:  WILL + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
              'Will it be sunny?'
  QISQA JAVOB:
              'Yes, it will.' / 'No, it won't.'

  DIQQAT: 'will' dan keyin fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
  ('will to go', 'will goes', 'will going' XATO).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a prediction        = bashorat
  an on-the-spot decision = shu payt qabul
                        qilingan qaror
  underwater          = suv ostidagi
  in 100 years' time  = 100 yildan keyin
  the day after tomorrow = indinga
  steak and chips     = bifshteks va qovurilgan
                        kartoshka

points.en: We use will to make predictions.
points.noteUz:
DALILSIZ bashorat — shunchaki fikr.
Dalil bo'lsa 'be going to' ishlatiladi.

points.en: In 100 years' time, there will be underwater cities.
points.uz: 100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
'in 100 years' TIME' — turg'un ibora.
Apostrof: 'years'' (ko'plikdan keyin).

points.en: We use will to make on-the-spot decisions.
points.uz: 'will' ni shu payt qabul qilingan qaror uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
'on the spot' = ayni damda, joyida.
Oldindan o'ylanmagan qaror.

points.en: I'll have soup first, then steak and chips.
points.uz: Avval sho'rva, keyin bifshteks va kartoshka olaman.
points.noteUz:
Menyuga qarab AYNI DAMDA hal qilindi.
'I will' → 'I'LL' (qisqargan shakl).

points.en: Time expressions used with future tenses: tomorrow, soon, next week/month/etc, the day after tomorrow, etc.
points.uz: Kelasi zamon bilan ishlatiladigan vaqt iboralari: ertaga, yaqinda, keyingi hafta/oy, indinga va h.k.

points.en: will + base form: I'll close the window. It won't rain. Will it be sunny? — Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
points.uz: will + asosiy fe'l: Derazani yopaman. Yomg'ir yog'maydi. Quyoshli bo'ladimi? — Ha. / Yo'q.
points.noteUz:
INKOR: WON'T (= will not).
SO'ROQ: WILL oldinga chiqadi.
'will to go', 'will goes' XATO.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the examples and say: a) which are predictions; b) which are on-the-spot decisions.
exercises.instructionUz: Namunalarni o'qing va ayting: a) qaysilari bashorat; b) qaysilari shu payt qabul qilingan qaror.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh GAP — ikki turga ajratiladi.

BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  ON-THE-SPOT DECISION  (shu payt qabul
                            qilingan qaror)
  2  PREDICTION            (bashorat)
  3  PREDICTION            (bashorat)
  4  ON-THE-SPOT DECISION
  5  PREDICTION

  BASHORATLAR:  2, 3, 5
  QARORLAR:     1, 4


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Sovqotdim. Derazani yopaman.
  2  50 yildan keyin, menimcha, ko'chalarda
     odamlardan ko'ra mashinalar ko'proq bo'ladi.
  3  Ertaga sovuq va yomg'irli bo'ladi.
  4  Qornim ochdi. O'zimga buterbrod tayyorlayman.
  5  100 yildan keyin odamlarda uchar mashinalar
     bo'ladi.


QANDAY AJRATISh — IKKI IP:

  IP 1 — VAQT IBORASI BORMI?
     'In 50 years' time', 'tomorrow',
     'In 100 years' time' →  BAShORAT
     (2, 3, 5-bandlar)

  IP 2 — OLDIDAN SABAB BORMI?
     'I'm cold.'  →  shuning uchun derazani
                     yopadi (QAROR)
     'I'm hungry.' →  shuning uchun buterbrod
                     tayyorlaydi (QAROR)
     (1, 4-bandlar)

  Ya'ni:
     QAROR — oldida HOZIRGI HOLAT aytiladi
             ('I'm cold', 'I'm hungry')
     BAShORAT — oldida KELAJAK VAQTI aytiladi
             ('In 50 years' time', 'tomorrow')


HAR BIRI ALOHIDA:

  1  'I'M COLD. I'll close the window.'
     Sovqotdi → ayni damda derazani yopishga
     qaror qildi. → QAROR

  2  'IN 50 YEARS' TIME, I THINK there will be
      more cars ...'
     'I think' + kelajak vaqti → BAShORAT

  3  'It will be cold and rainy TOMORROW.'
     Ob-havo bashorati → BAShORAT

  4  'I'M HUNGRY. I'll make myself a sandwich.'
     Qorni ochdi → ayni damda qaror qildi.
     → QAROR

  5  'IN 100 YEARS' TIME, people will have flying
      cars.'
     Uzoq kelajak haqida → BAShORAT


DIQQAT — 4-BANDDAGI 'MYSELF':
  'I'll make MYSELF a sandwich.'
  'myself' = o'zimga (o'zlik olmoshi).
  'make sb sth' = kimgadir nimadir tayyorlamoq.

DIQQAT — 2-BANDDAGI QIYOSIY DARAJA:
  'MORE cars ... THAN people'
  Unit 12 dagi qiyoslash.

items.textEn: 1  I'm cold. I'll close the window.
items.whyUz:
QAROR (on-the-spot decision).
Oldida HOZIRGI HOLAT: 'I'M COLD.'
Sovqotgani uchun AYNI DAMDA derazani yopishga
qaror qildi.
Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan.

items.textEn: 2  In 50 years' time, I think there will be more cars in the streets than people.
items.uz: 50 yildan keyin, menimcha, ko'chalarda odamlardan ko'ra mashinalar ko'proq bo'ladi.
items.whyUz:
BASHORAT (prediction).
IKKI IP: 'IN 50 YEARS' TIME' (kelajak vaqti)
va 'I THINK' (fikr).
Dalil yo'q — shunchaki taxmin.
DIQQAT: 'MORE cars THAN people' — qiyosiy daraja.

items.textEn: 3  It will be cold and rainy tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
BASHORAT.
'TOMORROW' — kelajak vaqt iborasi.
Ob-havo bashorati.
'It will be + SIFAT' qolipi (quyidagi qutiga
qarang).

items.textEn: 4  I'm hungry. I'll make myself a sandwich.
items.whyUz:
QAROR.
Oldida HOZIRGI HOLAT: 'I'M HUNGRY.'
Qorni ochgani uchun AYNI DAMDA qaror qildi.
'MYSELF' = o'zimga (o'zlik olmoshi).
1-band bilan bir xil naqsh.

items.textEn: 5  In 100 years' time, people will have flying cars.
items.uz: 100 yildan keyin odamlarda uchar mashinalar bo'ladi.
items.whyUz:
BASHORAT.
'IN 100 YEARS' TIME' — uzoq kelajak.
Qutidagi namuna bilan bir xil:
'In 100 years' time, there will be underwater
cities.'

exercises.instructionEn: It will be - There will be
exercises.instructionUz: It will be va There will be
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI — ENG QISQA, LEKIN JUDA MUHIM:

  'IT WILL BE + ADJECTIVE (SIFAT)'
     'It will be RAINY tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi.)

  'THERE WILL BE + NOUN (OT)'
     'There will be RAIN tomorrow.'
     (Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.)


ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?

     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


OB-HAVO JUFTLIKLARI — SIFAT va OT:

     SIFAT          OT
     ─────────────  ─────────────
     rainy          rain
     sunny          sunshine
     foggy          fog
     snowy          snow
     windy          strong winds
     cloudy         clouds
     stormy         a storm

  Har juftlik uchun ikki xil gap tuzish mumkin:
     'IT will be RAINY tomorrow.'    (sifat)
     'THERE will be RAIN tomorrow.'  (ot)
     Ma'no BIR XIL.


10a-MAShQDAGI NAMUNALAR — AYNAN ShU QOIDA:
  'IT will be SUNNY in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunny' — SIFAT → IT)
  'THERE will be SUNSHINE in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunshine' — OT → THERE)


DIQQAT — 'STRONG WINDS' KO'PLIK:
  'THERE WILL BE strong winds.'
  'wind' — sanaladigan ot bo'lishi mumkin;
  ob-havo haqida odatda KO'PLIK: 'strong winds'.

DIQQAT — 'SNOW' va 'SNOWY':
  'snow' — OT (SANALMAYDIGAN) → 'There will be
           SNOW.'
  'snowy' — SIFAT → 'It will be SNOWY.'
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 95-bet, 'It will be - There will be' qutisi

points.en: It will be + adjective: It will be rainy tomorrow.
points.uz: It will be + SIFAT: Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
SIFAT bo'lsa → 'IT will be'.
rainy, sunny, foggy, snowy, windy — sifatlar.

points.en: There will be + noun: There will be rain tomorrow.
points.uz: There will be + OT: Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.
points.noteUz:
OT bo'lsa → 'THERE will be'.
rain, sunshine, fog, snow, strong winds — otlar.

points.en: rainy (adj) ↔ rain (noun); sunny ↔ sunshine; foggy ↔ fog; snowy ↔ snow; windy ↔ strong winds
points.uz: rainy (sifat) ↔ rain (ot); sunny ↔ sunshine; foggy ↔ fog; snowy ↔ snow; windy ↔ strong winds
points.noteUz:
Har juftlik uchun IKKI xil gap tuzish mumkin.
Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat shakl boshqa.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the international weather chart and the symbols, then listen and tick the correct symbol. Finally make sentences, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Xalqaro ob-havo jadvaliga va belgilarga qarang, so'ng tinglang va to'g'ri belgini belgilang. Nihoyat, namunalardagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh BELGI (symbols):

     ☁☁  (kulrang qo'sh bulut)   = FOGGY / FOG
     ☁💨 (bulut puflab turibdi)  = WINDY /
                                   STRONG WINDS
     ☁💧 (bulutdan tomchilar)    = RAINY / RAIN
     ☀   (kulayotgan quyosh)     = SUNNY / SUNSHINE
     ☁❄  (bulutdan qor)          = SNOWY / SNOW


JADVALDA HAR ShAHAR UChUN IKKITA belgi bor —
BITTASINI tanlash kerak.


SAKKIZ ShAHARDAGI IKKI VARIANT:

  Bangkok    :  ☀ sunny   |  ☁💨 windy
  Harare     :  ☁❄ snowy  |  ☁💨 windy
  Sydney     :  ☁💧 rainy  |  ☀ sunny
  Dublin     :  ☁☁ foggy  |  ☁💧 rainy
  Tokyo      :  ☁☁ foggy  |  ☁💧 rainy
  New York   :  ☁💨 windy  |  ☁☁ foggy
  Seoul      :  ☁💧 rainy  |  ☁💨 windy
  Warsaw     :  ☁💧 rainy  |  ☁❄ snowy


JAVOBLAR — OLTITASI KITOBNING O'ZIDAN:

  BANGKOK  →  SUNNY
     Kitob QIZIL STRELKA bilan ko'rsatgan,
     va namunada aytilgan:
     'It will be SUNNY in Bangkok tomorrow.'

  DUBLIN   →  FOGGY
     10c-mashqning 1-bandi:
     '... will be FOGGY in Dublin tomorrow.'
     10b-namunasi ham tasdiqlaydi:
     'Will it be sunny in Dublin tomorrow?'
     'No, it won't.'

  HARARE   →  WINDY
     10c-mashqning 2-bandi:
     '... will be STRONG WINDS in Harare tomorrow.'

  SEOUL    →  RAINY
     10c-mashqning 3-bandi:
     '... will be RAINY in Seoul tomorrow.'

  SYDNEY   →  SUNNY
     10c-mashqning 4-bandi:
     '... will be SUNNY in Sydney tomorrow.'

  WARSAW   →  SNOWY
     10c-mashqning 5-bandi:
     '... will be SNOW in Warsaw tomorrow.'


⚠ IKKI ShAHAR AUDIODAN ANIQLANADI:

  TOKYO     —  foggy yoki rainy?
  NEW YORK  —  windy yoki foggy?

  Bu ikki shahar 10c-mashqda eslatilmagan va
  jadvalda strelka ham yo'q. Ularni faqat AUDIO
  aytadi. Taxmin qilib yozib qo'yish noto'g'ri
  bo'lardi — shuning uchun OChIQ qoldirildi.


KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA GAP:
  'IT will be SUNNY in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunny' — SIFAT → IT)
  'THERE will be SUNSHINE in Bangkok tomorrow.'
     ('sunshine' — OT → THERE)

  Ya'ni har shahar uchun IKKI xil gap tuziladi.


BARCHA GAPLAR (aniqlangan olti shahar uchun):

  BANGKOK (sunny):
     It will be sunny in Bangkok tomorrow.
     There will be sunshine in Bangkok tomorrow.

  DUBLIN (foggy):
     It will be foggy in Dublin tomorrow.
     There will be fog in Dublin tomorrow.

  HARARE (windy):
     It will be windy in Harare tomorrow.
     There will be strong winds in Harare tomorrow.

  SEOUL (rainy):
     It will be rainy in Seoul tomorrow.
     There will be rain in Seoul tomorrow.

  SYDNEY (sunny):
     It will be sunny in Sydney tomorrow.
     There will be sunshine in Sydney tomorrow.

  WARSAW (snowy):
     It will be snowy in Warsaw tomorrow.
     There will be snow in Warsaw tomorrow.


ShAHARLAR HAQIDA:
  Bangkok  — Tailand poytaxti
  Harare   — Zimbabve poytaxti (Afrika)
  Sydney   — Avstraliyaning eng katta shahri
  Dublin   — Irlandiya poytaxti
  Tokyo    — Yaponiya poytaxti
  New York — AQShdagi eng katta shahar
  Seoul    — Janubiy Koreya poytaxti
  Warsaw   — Polsha poytaxti

Namunada ham: 'It will be SUNNY in Bangkok
tomorrow.'

tomorrow?' — 'Yes, it will.'

'... will be FOGGY in Dublin tomorrow.'

tomorrow?' — 'No, it won't.'

Harare — Zimbabve poytaxti (Afrika);
u yerda qor yog'maydi — mantiq ham mos.

10c-mashqning 3-bandidan TASDIQLANGAN:

'... will be SUNNY in Sydney tomorrow.'

10c-mashqning 5-bandidan TASDIQLANGAN:

DIQQAT: 10c da OT ('snow') ishlatilgan →

⚠ Bu shahar 10c-mashqda ESLATILMAGAN va

Uni faqat AUDIO aytadi.
Taxmin qilib yozish noto'g'ri bo'lardi —

Qaysi biri chiqsa ham, gap qolipi shu:
  foggy → 'It will be foggy in Tokyo tomorrow.'
           'There will be fog in Tokyo tomorrow.'

Uni faqat AUDIO aytadi.

Qaysi biri chiqsa ham, gap qolipi shu:

           'There will be strong winds in New York

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda namunadagidek savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'WILL IT BE sunny in Bangkok tomorrow?'
  SB: 'YES, IT WILL.'
  SA: 'WILL IT BE sunny in Dublin tomorrow?'
  SB: 'NO, IT WON'T.'


QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  WILL IT BE + sifat + in [shahar]
          tomorrow?
  JAVOB:  Yes, it will. / No, it won't.


DIQQAT — SO'ROQ TARTIBI:
  'WILL it be sunny?'  ✓
  'It will be sunny?'  ✗ (so'roq emas)
  'Does it will be sunny?'  ✗ ('do' KERAK EMAS)


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOB:
  'Yes, it WILL.'      ✓
  'No, it WON'T.'      ✓ (won't = will not)
  'Yes, it will be.'   — to'liq, lekin qisqa
                         javob emas
  'No, it doesn't.'    ✗


NAMUNA SAVOL-JAVOBLAR (aniqlangan shaharlar):

  SA: Will it be sunny in Bangkok tomorrow?
  SB: Yes, it will.                     (NAMUNA)

  SA: Will it be sunny in Dublin tomorrow?
  SB: No, it won't. It will be foggy.   (NAMUNA)

  SA: Will it be windy in Harare tomorrow?
  SB: Yes, it will.

  SA: Will it be snowy in Harare tomorrow?
  SB: No, it won't.

  SA: Will it be rainy in Seoul tomorrow?
  SB: Yes, it will.

  SA: Will it be sunny in Sydney tomorrow?
  SB: Yes, it will.

  SA: Will it be rainy in Sydney tomorrow?
  SB: No, it won't.

  SA: Will it be snowy in Warsaw tomorrow?
  SB: Yes, it will.

  SA: Will it be rainy in Warsaw tomorrow?
  SB: No, it won't.


DIQQAT — 'NO' JAVOBIDAN KEYIN TUZATISh:
  Kitobning namunasida faqat 'No, it won't.' bor,
  lekin to'g'ri javobni qo'shish ham mumkin:
     'No, it won't. It will be foggy.'
  Bu — 94-betdagi Game mashqi bilan bir xil usul.

exercises.explanationUz:
QOIDA (yuqoridagi qutidan):

  Bo'shliqdan keyin SIFAT bormi yoki OT?
     SIFAT  →  IT will be
     OT     →  THERE will be


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  IT     will be FOGGY in Dublin tomorrow.
  2  THERE  will be STRONG WINDS in Harare
            tomorrow.
  3  IT     will be RAINY in Seoul tomorrow.
  4  IT     will be SUNNY in Sydney tomorrow.
  5  THERE  will be SNOW in Warsaw tomorrow.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Ertaga Dublinda tumanli bo'ladi.
  2  Ertaga Harareda kuchli shamollar bo'ladi.
  3  Ertaga Seulda yomg'irli bo'ladi.
  4  Ertaga Sidneyda quyoshli bo'ladi.
  5  Ertaga Varshavada qor bo'ladi.


HAR BIRI QANDAY ANIQLANADI:

  1  'foggy' — SIFAT ('-y' bilan tugaydi) → IT
  2  'strong winds' — OT (ko'plik) → THERE
  3  'rainy' — SIFAT ('-y') → IT
  4  'sunny' — SIFAT ('-y') → IT
  5  'snow' — OT (sanalmaydigan) → THERE


ENG SODDA IP — '-Y' HARFI:
  Ob-havo so'zi '-y' bilan tugasa — SIFAT → IT:
     fogGY, rainY, sunnY, snowY, windY, cloudY
  '-y' siz bo'lsa — OT → THERE:
     fog, rain, sunshine, snow, winds, clouds

  Bu — 5 tadan 5 tasini to'g'ri hal qiladi.


DIQQAT — 2 va 5-BANDLAR:
  Kitob ataylab OTLARNI ishlatgan ('strong winds',
  'snow'), sifat emas — shuning uchun 'THERE'.
  Agar sifat ishlatilganda bo'lardi:
     'IT will be WINDY in Harare tomorrow.'
     'IT will be SNOWY in Warsaw tomorrow.'
  Ma'no BIR XIL.


DIQQAT — 10a-MAShQNING JAVOBI ShU YERDA:
  Bu besh gap 10a-mashqdagi besh shaharning
  ob-havosini OChIQ aytadi:
     Dublin — foggy
     Harare — windy
     Seoul  — rainy
     Sydney — sunny
     Warsaw — snowy
  Ya'ni 10a ning katta qismini audio TINGLAMASDAN
hal qilish mumkin.

items.textEn: 1  ............ will be foggy in Dublin tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'foggy' — SIFAT ('-y' bilan tugaydi) → IT.
'IT will be + SIFAT'.
Bu gap 10a-mashqda Dublin uchun FOGGY belgisini
tanlash kerakligini ham ko'rsatadi.

items.textEn: 2  ............ will be strong winds in Harare tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'strong winds' — OT (ko'plik) → THERE.
'THERE will be + OT'.
Agar sifat ishlatilganda: 'IT will be WINDY.'
Ma'no bir xil.
Bu gap 10a da Harare uchun WINDY belgisini
tasdiqlaydi.

items.textEn: 3  ............ will be rainy in Seoul tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'rainy' — SIFAT ('-y') → IT.
OT shakli 'rain' bo'lardi:
'THERE will be RAIN in Seoul tomorrow.'
Bu gap 10a da Seoul uchun RAINY belgisini
tasdiqlaydi.

items.textEn: 4  ............ will be sunny in Sydney tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'sunny' — SIFAT ('-y') → IT.
OT shakli 'sunshine' bo'lardi:
'THERE will be SUNSHINE in Sydney tomorrow.'
10a-mashqning namunasida ham aynan shu juftlik
Bangkok uchun ko'rsatilgan.

items.textEn: 5  ............ will be snow in Warsaw tomorrow.
items.whyUz:
'snow' — OT (sanalmaydigan) → THERE.
SIFAT shakli 'snowy' bo'lardi:
'IT will be SNOWY in Warsaw tomorrow.'
Bu gap 10a da Warsaw uchun SNOWY belgisini
tasdiqlaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the prompts and match them to the correct on-the-spot decisions, then make sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni o'qing va ularni to'g'ri qarorlarga moslang, so'ng namunadagidek gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
YETTI HOLAT va YETTI QAROR.

  HOLATLAR (prompts):
     I'm thirsty.          (Chanqadim.)
     It's raining.         (Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
     It's cold.            (Sovuq.)
     I'm tired.            (Charchadim.)
     I'm hungry.           (Qornim ochdi.)
     It's hot.             (Issiq.)
     The house is on fire. (Uy yonyapti.)

  QARORLAR (on-the-spot decisions):
     close the window       (derazani yopmoq)
     have a sandwich        (buterbrod yemoq)
     have a glass of water  (bir stakan suv ichmoq)
     call the fire brigade  (o't o'chiruvchilarni
                             chaqirmoq)
     go to bed              (yotmoq)
     open the window        (derazani ochmoq)
     put on my raincoat     (plash kiymoq)


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I'm thirsty. I'LL HAVE a glass of water.'


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

  I'm thirsty.          →  have a glass of water
  It's raining.         →  put on my raincoat
  It's cold.            →  close the window
  I'm tired.            →  go to bed
  I'm hungry.           →  have a sandwich
  It's hot.             →  open the window
  The house is on fire. →  call the fire brigade


BARCHA GAPLAR:

  I'm thirsty. I'll have a glass of water.
                                       (NAMUNA)
  It's raining. I'll put on my raincoat.
  It's cold. I'll close the window.
  I'm tired. I'll go to bed.
  I'm hungry. I'll have a sandwich.
  It's hot. I'll open the window.
  The house is on fire. I'll call the fire
  brigade.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Chanqadim. Bir stakan suv ichaman.
  Yomg'ir yog'yapti. Plash kiyaman.
  Sovuq. Derazani yopaman.
  Charchadim. Yotaman.
  Qornim ochdi. Buterbrod yeyman.
  Issiq. Derazani ochaman.
  Uy yonyapti. O't o'chiruvchilarni chaqiraman.


QOLIP:
  [HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.

  Birinchi qism — HOZIRGI holat (sabab).
  Ikkinchi qism — AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan qaror.

  Bu — 9-mashqning 1 va 4-bandlari bilan
  BIR XIL naqsh:
     'I'm cold. I'll close the window.'
     'I'm hungry. I'll make myself a sandwich.'


DIQQAT — IKKI ALDAMChI JUFTLIK:

  'It's COLD' → CLOSE the window
  'It's HOT'  → OPEN the window

  Ikkalasi ham deraza haqida, lekin TESKARI
  harakat. Diqqat bilan o'qing.


DIQQAT — 'PUT ON':
  'put on' = kiymoq.
  'put ON my raincoat' — ikki so'zli fe'l.
  Aksi: 'take off' (yechmoq).

DIQQAT — 'THE FIRE BRIGADE':
  'the fire brigade' = o't o'chirish xizmati
  (Britaniya varianti).
  Amerikada: 'the fire department'.
  'on fire' = yonmoqda.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  thirsty      = chanqagan
  a raincoat   = plash, yomg'irpo'sh
  a fire brigade = o't o'chirish xizmati
  on fire      = yonmoqda
  a glass of water = bir stakan suv

pairs.right: have a glass of water  →  I'm thirsty. I'll have a glass of water.
pairs.rightUz: bir stakan suv ichmoq → Chanqadim. Bir stakan suv ichaman.
pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Chanqagan odam SUV ichadi.
'a glass of water' — o'lchov iborasi
('water' sanalmaydigan).

pairs.right: put on my raincoat  →  It's raining. I'll put on my raincoat.
pairs.rightUz: plash kiymoq → Yomg'ir yog'yapti. Plash kiyaman.
pairs.whyUz:
Yomg'irda PLASH kiyiladi.
'a RAINcoat' — 'rain' so'zi ichida, bu ANIQ ip.
'put on' = kiymoq (aksi: 'take off').

pairs.right: close the window  →  It's cold. I'll close the window.
pairs.whyUz:
Sovuq bo'lsa deraza YOPILADI.
9-mashqning 1-bandi ham aynan shu:
'I'm cold. I'll close the window.'
DIQQAT: 'It's hot' bandi bilan CHALKASHTIRMANG.

pairs.right: go to bed  →  I'm tired. I'll go to bed.
pairs.whyUz:
Charchagan odam YOTADI.
'go to bed' — artikl YO'Q (turg'un ibora).
'go to THE bed' XATO.

pairs.right: have a sandwich  →  I'm hungry. I'll have a sandwich.
pairs.rightUz: buterbrod yemoq → Qornim ochdi. Buterbrod yeyman.
pairs.whyUz:
Qorni ochgan odam OVQAT yeydi.
9-mashqning 4-bandi ham shunga o'xshash:
'I'm hungry. I'll make myself a sandwich.'
'have a sandwich' = buterbrod yemoq.

pairs.right: open the window  →  It's hot. I'll open the window.
pairs.whyUz:
Issiq bo'lsa deraza OChILADI.
DIQQAT: 'It's cold' bandi bilan TESKARI —
ikkalasi ham deraza haqida, lekin harakat
qarama-qarshi.

pairs.right: call the fire brigade  →  The house is on fire. I'll call the fire brigade.
pairs.rightUz: o't o'chiruvchilarni chaqirmoq → Uy yonyapti. O't o'chiruvchilarni chaqiraman.
pairs.whyUz:
Yong'inda O'T O'ChIRUVChILAR chaqiriladi.
'on fire' = yonmoqda.
'the fire brigade' — Britaniya varianti;
Amerikada 'the fire department'.

patterns.formula: A BECAUSE B.  /  B, SO A.  /  A TO + fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Tony is going to save money because he wants to go on holiday. / Tony wants to go on holiday, so he is going to save money. / Tony is going to save money to go on holiday.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni pul yig'moqchi, chunki ta'tilga bormoqchi. / Toni ta'tilga bormoqchi, shuning uchun pul yig'moqchi. / Toni ta'tilga borish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Bir fikrni UCH xil aytish.
'because' va 'so' da TARTIB TESKARI.
'to + fe'l' — eng qisqa shakl.

patterns.formula: [HOZIRGI HOLAT]. I'LL + ASOSIY fe'l.   (shu payt qabul qilingan qaror)
patterns.exampleEn: I'm cold. I'll close the window. I'm thirsty. I'll have a glass of water.
patterns.exampleUz: Sovqotdim. Derazani yopaman. Chanqadim. Bir stakan suv ichaman.
patterns.explanationUz:
Avval HOLAT (sabab), keyin QAROR.
Qaror AYNI DAMDA qabul qilingan.

patterns.exampleEn: In 100 years' time, there will be underwater cities.
patterns.exampleUz: 100 yildan keyin suv ostida shaharlar bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Uzoq kelajak haqidagi BASHORAT.
Dalil yo'q — shunchaki fikr.

patterns.formula: IT will be + SIFAT.   /   THERE will be + OT.
patterns.exampleEn: It will be rainy tomorrow. There will be rain tomorrow.
patterns.exampleUz: Ertaga yomg'irli bo'ladi. Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.
patterns.explanationUz:
SIFAT → IT, OT → THERE.
Ma'no BIR XIL, faqat shakl boshqa.
ENG SODDA IP: '-y' bilan tugasa — sifat.

patterns.formula: WILL IT BE + sifat + in [joy] tomorrow?  —  Yes, it will. / No, it won't.
patterns.exampleEn: Will it be sunny in Bangkok tomorrow? — Yes, it will.
patterns.explanationUz:
So'roqda 'WILL' OLDINGA chiqadi.
Qisqa javobda 'be' TAKRORLANMAYDI.
'won't' = 'will not'.
